🚨 @seshajoi, @butterflyslh, @mayatep, @enjolimoon, and @thejxnproject came through to discuss their upcoming film, Declarations: Black Americans and the Revolutionary War, premiering on 6/29. They speak about the power that comes from Black people being in rooms where they can learn, gain access, and bring that knowledge back to create opportunities for their communities.
Check out the full conversation on @Netflix. 🎥
